typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOpicsFXVolumeWeeklyArchive_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		LoadDate as string,
		Business_Group as string,
		STP_NonSTP as string,
		Count as string,
		Source as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> tblOpicsFXVolumeWeeklyStaging
tblOpicsFXVolumeWeeklyStaging sink(input(
		LoadDate as string,
		Business_Group as string,
		STP_NonSTP as string,
		Count as string,
		Source as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		Business_Group,
		STP_NonSTP,
		Count,
		Source),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpicsFXVolumeWeeklyArchive_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOpicsFXVolumeWeeklyArchive
